description: Traverse the capability spine joining books, guides (capability packages), KSAO-grade elements and jobs. Use min_guides=2 for the cross-cutting capabilities that span many guides, role=<role> for what a job requires, capability_detail=<slug> for one package with its elements and books hydrated. ksao_type/canon_component_id are null by design where unresolved — treat null as 'not yet joined', never as 'no link'.

canon_promotion_candidate.description: true = only elements the JobFrame canon has NO component for. This is a real answer, not a failed lookup — these are the constructs to PROMOTE into the canon.

capability.description: Elements taught by this capability (guide slug).

capability_detail.description: Return ONE capability with its elements and books hydrated, instead of querying elements.

conflicting.description: Only elements where 2+ non-career guides define the same label differently — these need a ruling.

construct_class.description: person-attribute (knowledge/skill/ability — what a JOB requires and a learner develops) | condition-or-outcome (what a capability PRODUCES, e.g. 'Retention & Workforce Stability'). Only ~30% of elements are person attributes — filter to these for 'what does this role need'.

has_canon_identity.description: true = only elements resolved to a JobFrame canon component (an IDENTITY, panel-adjudicated). false = only unresolved.

has_job.description: Only elements that some job requires (via a career guide).

ksao_type.description: knowledge | skill | ability | other — from a panel validated at 95.1% on gold O*NET labels. 'other' is UNVALIDATED (no gold labels existed for it).

limit.description: Cap the rows returned (default 200). `total` always reports the true count.

min_guides.description: Only elements taught by >= N capabilities. 2 gives the cross-cutting spine.

q.description: Substring match on the element label.

role.description: Elements required by this job role, e.g. compensation-analyst.

name: list_capabilities
title: Traverse the capability spine (books · guides · KSAO elements · jobs)
